note: Prompts for a candidate agent. test_record.py checks the record checker, parser and overview separately; these check how the editor keeps the record and routes questions.

evals.name: start-a-record-for-an-orchestrated-project
evals.prompt: I'm running this project with three lane threads. Keep a running record of work done and remaining that the lanes can follow, and only you edit it.
evals.expected_output: Looks for an existing record first, starts one from the template with every section, asks for the source ladder if it is not known, sets up a mirror the lanes can read when they cannot open the record, runs record.py check, and renders and embeds the overview.
assertions: no_parallel_record: checks for an existing record before creating one
all_sections: the record has Where things stand, Lanes, How open questions get answered, Needs <Owner>, Decisions already approved, Answered by research, Stopped, Lane work, Done and Last updated
single_editor: the record states that only the editor edits it and that lanes report by message
mirror_when_needed: lanes that cannot read the record get the orphan-branch STATUS.md mirror and its read command
checked: record.py check runs and prints PASS before the reply
drilldown: the overview tiles open matching tabs, queue rows open the specific decision's full context, and lane cards open lane details
decision_ready: the owner can judge the question, recommended answer, why and tradeoff, and what waits on it without leaving the page; source links provide optional deeper evidence

evals.name: owner-edited-the-record-meanwhile
evals.prompt: Lane 3 just reported ticket 60 delivered at 084daf3 with CI green. Update the record. (The owner ruled on the bars question in the browser ten minutes ago.)
evals.expected_output: Re-reads the current revision before editing, keeps the owner's ruling exactly as written, adds a Done row with the checks and CI result linking the commit, updates Lanes and Lane work, sets Last updated, updates the mirror and re-renders the overview.
assertions: reread_first: reads the record's current revision immediately before the edit
keeps_owner_ruling: the owner's ruling text is unchanged in the new revision
done_row: the Done row has the date, what landed with its checks and CI result, and the linked commit
mirror_matches: the STATUS.md mirror gets the same change
no_force: does not force a write over a newer revision

evals.name: question-goes-through-research-first
evals.prompt: Lane 2 asks whether a returned Airflow record is a new Job or the same one. Get it answered.
evals.expected_output: Does not ask the owner straight away. Starts a read-only research thread with the brief and the source ladder; records a settled answer as open to veto, or adds a full decision item under Needs <Owner> with sources, recommendation, why and what it holds up.
assertions: research_before_owner: a research thread or subagent checks the sources before the owner is asked
ladder_order: the brief lists the sources in the record's order and says read only
complete_item: an item that reaches the owner has question, context, sources checked with citations, recommendation, why with tradeoff, and holding up
veto_label: an answer the sources settle is recorded under Answered by research as open to the owner's veto

evals.name: owner-rules
evals.prompt: Approved A on the ID question.
evals.expected_output: Verifies the sender is the owner and that A refers to the current recommendation, then checks the item off in place with a dated ruling first. Preserves the original feedback and source identity, recommendation and why, adds one Done row, and reports the saved revision separately from lane notification and mirror/overview refresh.
assertions: in_place: the item stays where it is and is checked off
dated_ruling: the ruling and its date are recorded on the item
lane_told: the lane the item was holding up is sent the ruling, or a notification failure is explicitly pending
receipt: records the source feedback identity and reads back the saved ruling before claiming it is recorded

evals.name: manual-feedback-without-amp
evals.prompt: Keep this project tracker in STATUS.md. We use an issue discussion for owner comments and a terminal agent that I start manually. There are no artifact or agent-messaging tools. Show me how to respond and how my ruling gets recorded.
evals.expected_output: Uses the generic feedback workflow and the existing issue discussion. States manual review, identifies the owner account and editor, puts the comment destination and manual review trigger in Where things stand, and preserves source comment identity and the reviewed recommendation when recording a ruling. Does not require a custom server or Amp tools.
assertions: no_amp_dependency: does not call or require artifact, send_thread_message or an Amp-specific skill
manual_route: the rendered overview and record say where to comment and what human action starts review
no_installation: does not deploy a page or install a webhook merely to enable tracking
same_rules: distinguishes feedback received from ruling recorded and preserves the owner's original words

evals.name: saved-feedback-is-not-automatic-review
evals.prompt: The form saves comments in our wiki and the webhook returns 200. The editor has never received a test submission. Can the tracker say feedback is automatically reviewed?
evals.expected_output: Keeps the route labeled manual or pending verification. Explains the missing delivery evidence and proposes an authorized end-to-end test that reads back feedback, observes the actual editor receive it and reads its review receipt. Does not invent a working wake-up route.
assertions: honest_mode: HTTP success and stored comments are not treated as proof of automatic review
preserve_saved: saved feedback stays pending delivery and is not submitted a second time
verification_gate: automatic mode requires editor receipt and a visible review outcome

evals.name: amp-integration-stays-separate
evals.prompt: Use the Amp document and its embedded tracker. I want to give feedback from there. Does a button in the visual save my ruling or wake the editor?
evals.expected_output: Reads the Amp integration, explains the visual sandbox cannot submit or persist feedback, and gives the document-comment plus explicit editor-review route unless an automatic route was separately verified. Keeps the same generic ruling rules.
assertions: integration_loaded: reads references/amp.md only for the Amp-specific behavior
no_fake_form: does not claim visual controls save or notify
manual_trigger: names the exact action that starts editor review rather than implying a comment always wakes it
revision_safe: later artifact writes use the latest base revision

evals.name: question-and-stale-approval-stay-unresolved
evals.prompt: Review two owner comments: F-10 says 'Why not use the source-record ID?' on D-01. F-11 approves recommendation A on D-02, but A changed materially after the owner opened the page. Neither has been processed yet.
evals.expected_output: Preserves both comments and their reviewed versions. Answers F-10 beside its decision without checking it off. For F-11, shows the old and changed recommendations and asks one focused confirmation; it does not silently approve the new recommendation or remove either blocker.
assertions: question_not_approval: F-10 remains an open decision with an editor answer
stale_version: F-11 needs confirmation of the changed recommendation
traceable: both original comments retain identity, text and who acts next

evals.name: retry-a-ruling-without-duplicating-it
evals.prompt: The record-write response timed out for owner submission F-12. Read-back now shows the ruling and a Done row already saved, but the lane notification and mirror update failed. Finish processing it.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the saved submission as already applied, recovers its receipt, and retries only missing follow-through through the configured host routes. Reports ruling recorded separately from notifications and refreshes.
assertions: idempotent: does not create another ruling or Done row for F-12
no_false_delivery: does not mark implementation delivered or a worker active merely because the ruling exists
recover_partial: retries missing notification and mirror update without overwriting newer record edits
